description: This is a Perl script designed for downloading files from various sources with support for mirrors, checksum verification, and different download tools. It manages mirror selection, verifies file integrity, and handles local and remote file retrieval.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and configuration, returning a list of mirror URLs.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Loads project-specific mirrors from a JSON configuration file, appending to the mirrors list.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a given program in the system's PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command (md5 or sha256) based on the checksum length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a specific download tool (curl, wget) is available by verifying its version.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the best available download tool based on environment variables and availability.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command to download files using the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download either from local directory or via network, handling hash verification.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during download process.
